notes.title: New Home Event - Update 1.1.5
notes.notes:
In celebration of our moving in a new home, I present to you Update 1.1.5:

- Added a small celebration at the end of each puzzle, the game now properly cheers you on after all your efforts!

- Added a button to export a finished puzzle to Desktop, you can now use all your puzzles as Wallpapers!

notes.title: Small Update 1.0.9c : Bugfix
notes.notes:
- Fixed loading/reloading puzzles quickly could crash
- Fixed Helios Temple pieces selection zone

notes.title: Small Update 1.0.9: Bugfix
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug with the Resume button (would try to load solved pieces twice)

notes.title: Small Patch 1.0.8
notes.notes: - limited max FPS on top of Vsync, might be cause for bugs?

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.4b: Helios Temple fix
notes.notes: - Foolishly forgot a piece from the new puzzle Helios Temple, sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Update 1.04: Zoom function and a new Puzzle
notes.notes:

- Added puzzle n°25:  Helios Temple  (130p)

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 : Bugs and Resolution
notes.notes:
- Fixed a critical bug: Shuffling with under 5 pieces would crash the game
- Added Aspect Ratio support: testing a fix for ratios other than 16:9, work in progress
- Fixed Cathedral Dusk Puzzle: puzzle had a "Ghost Piece"

notes.title: Update 1.0.2: Proper Memory Management
notes.notes: - Fixed the way the assets were loaded, drastically lowering the RAM consumption

notes.title: Update 1.0.1: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed a memory leak
- Fixed Shuffle Button with a Piece in hand, Piece is now put down and shuffled
